rv.q: Metropolis Performing Arts' “Xanadu” gives you that opportunity to revel in absurdity and get in on the joke (and the fun!).
The theatrical equivalent of cotton candy, “Xanadu” is a sweet treat.
So, if you are looking to kick back, laugh, and be entertained, Xanadu is a perfect option.

cn.t: This cheerfully silly spoof of the notorious 1980 film flop embraces its campy source material with infectious energy, delivering 90 minutes of lighthearted, cheese-filled fun that keeps audiences chuckling throughout.
